resize.note: Heights are getBoundingClientRect().height in CSS px at a 1280x1000 viewport with the message column fixed at 768px, Tailwind v3 preflight reproduced (border-width:0 and iframe{display:block}). The column width is an input, recorded so the numbers reproduce.

resize-verdicts.why that number: the package sets height:100% inline; both containers are auto-height, so the percentage resolves to auto and the box falls back to the UA intrinsic iframe height. Dropping Tailwind's preflight puts the UA's 2px iframe border back and the same box measures 154px.
resize-verdicts.negative control, autoResizeIframe absen: 150px -> 150px, and the host logged 1 message receipt(s) from that frame, so the unchanged height is a refusal and not a lost message
resize-verdicts.negative control, same message from the: every slot stayed at 150px, so the source gate holds and "the box moved" is not just "any message moves it"
resize-verdicts.after ui-size-change height:20000: 20000px, inline height 20000px — applied verbatim, so there is no host-side clamp
